summary: Iteration 2 — Portfolio gallery (seeded 8 real client photos) fully tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (/api/media returns 8 seeded photos with correct id/url/title/category/description/price/rating 5.0/media_type; title+category+price match spec for all 8; GET /api/media/file/{path} returns 200 image/jpeg; owner-authenticated POST /api/media with description+price returns rating 5.0 and category 'Party & Prom', then DELETE soft-deletes it and 8 seeded photos remain intact; POST /api/media without auth returns 401; prior iteration-1 settings & inquiry tests still green). Frontend: portfolio section renders heading 'Our Real Transformations & Client Gallery'; filter counts exact — All 8, Bridal Glam 3, Soft / Natural 2, Party & Prom 2, Eye & Brows 1 (Bridal Glam / Full Glam item correctly matches Bridal Glam tab); all 8 cards show gold '5.0 ★' badge via data-testid=gallery-rating-badge; clicking card opens gallery-lightbox with image/caption/category/description/price/book-btn; Book This Look href starts with https://wa.me/639558896008?text= and contains encoded look title; next/prev cycle, Escape closes. Admin /admin login works; admin-description-input, admin-price-input, admin-category-select with all 5 required options (Bridal Glam, Soft / Natural, Party & Prom, Eye & Brows, Bridal Glam / Full Glam) present; admin-media-list renders 8 seeded items with 'Category · Price' text. Regression: before-after-slider renders, Portfolio nav anchor present, Studio Settings panel + Inquiry Inbox still functional. Seeded photos were NOT deleted.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning from iteration_1: preview tooling injects a <span> wrapper inside the rating <option> element in Admin.jsx around line 389 ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Visual-editor artifact only; functionality intact. Carrying forward from iteration 1.

action_items: Carry-over from iteration 1 (not re-verified-fixed): Footer.jsx should filter out empty social links before rendering so empty settings hide the icon per spec. Also optional: silence the <option><span> hydration warning in Admin.jsx rating select.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload_media: `title` and `category` are stripped and default-filled, but there is no server-side whitelist of allowed categories — any string is accepted. Admin UI constrains it, but a direct API call could insert categories that won't match any filter tab and will silently fall into 'All Looks' only. Consider validating category against the frontend FILTERS list.

Portfolio.jsx: items are keyed/ordered by created_at desc (server-side) — if admin uploads new photos, newest first will shift indexes. GalleryCard passes `index` to the lightbox opener; lightbox prev/next uses `(index +/- items.length) % items.length` — works because `items` in the lightbox is the filtered list from the parent and the parent re-renders. OK as-is.
GalleryLightbox: uses item.id as key but does not guard against `items` becoming empty while a lightbox is open (e.g., deletion). Edge case; low priority.
serialize_media exposes `created_at` directly from Mongo — stored as ISO string so safe; just noting consistency.
No pagination on GET /api/media (hard limit 500) — fine for current scale but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: No persistent new seed data. The pytest media upload test creates and then DELETES a single 1x1 PNG titled 'TEST_Upload Playwright' in the same test. Iteration-1 'TEST_Playwright' inquiry still present (expected). All 8 seeded gallery photos remain intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (18 tests, pytest -n auto compatible, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Portfolio filter button data-testid slug rules: strip to lowercase, replace non-letters with '-', strip trailing '-'. Examples: 'All Looks' -> gallery-filter-all-looks-btn; 'Soft / Natural' -> gallery-filter-soft-natural-btn; 'Party & Prom' -> gallery-filter-party-prom-btn. For Playwright with Lenis smooth scroll, call window.__lenis?.destroy() and page.goto wait_until='load' (networkidle hangs on Google Maps iframe); after filter click wait ~1.4s for AnimatePresence exit animations. Lightbox book-btn href encodes title via waLink helper. 8 seeded media titles are stable; test by filtering `title in EXPECTED_TITLES` to be safe against future test uploads.
